description: Updates the metadata of an existing dossier (name, template fields, expiry). Requires: dossier_create → dossierId, caseFileId. Only available while dossier is in DRAFT status.

embeddedEvidences.description: Optional. true embeds the evidence files linked to this dossier as attachments inside the dossier certificate PDF; false does not (false is what dossier_create stores by default). GoCertius does not offer evidence embedding: on this deployment dossier_create always stores false, whatever is sent. Leave this field unset on GoCertius.

name: dossier_update
